title: Weeknight Chicken Parm Casserole
description: An easy weeknight chicken parm casserole.

ingredients.item: a dice (assumed to be chicken or vegetable dice, approximately 1 cup)
Chicken thighs, seasoned with salt and pepper

steps: Add half of a dice onto a hot oiled pan and cook until tender and golden.
Add the whole bell pepper, stir, and cook for a couple of minutes.
Add minced garlic cloves and cook for about a minute.
Make the sauce by adding tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, chopped basil, oregano, and red pepper flakes; stir and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for about 10 minutes.
Pour the sauce into a 9x13 baking dish.
Place seasoned chicken thighs into the sauce.
In a small mixing bowl, combine panko breadcrumbs, Parmesan cheese, oregano, basil, and olive oil; stir until combined.
Spoon heaping piles of the breadcrumb mixture onto each chicken thigh.
Bake in the oven at 350°F (175°C) for about 45 minutes.
Serve the chicken thighs over pasta.
notes:
Serve over cooked pasta for a complete meal.
